scope: Offline artifact checks only. Not application, Qt, agent runtime, installed skill or live GitHub evidence.

unittest.description: Pack integrity, dependency/ownership checks and synthetic wire, protocol and UTF-8 splice examples; negative fixtures are resealed to exercise semantic validation.

checksums: SHA256SUMS seals all payload files including this report; the checksum file itself is excluded.

Live GitHub.com or GHES calls, publication or website acceptance
Live repository RFC/issue allocation or HEAD verification
